name: combat-ux-space-menu
description: combat-ux: the manual space-combat menu offers no transported infantry, and a stale 'destroy infantry' press is refused by the engine (CombatAssignUnitsKind.validate) and by the bot handler (AssignHitsButtonHandlers.refuseIllegalHit). mentak, 2 infantry in 308 space, pbd60@131. The stale gf button is not on the bot's menu any more, so the harness re-posts it as a message of its own (the legacy handler then refreshes that message into a menu): that harness-made copy is deleted at the end so 'no assign_units open' checks the real menu, which Done closed.
